mapper.sql: p.*, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, st.settlement_no, st.period_start, st.exchange_rate AS settlement_rate, st.fin_settlement_id, a.name AS account_name, v.voucher_no
LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = p.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = p.settlement_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = p.account_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = p.voucher_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, s.name AS store_name, st.settlement_no FROM ecom_payout p JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = p.settlement_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = p.store_id WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' AND p.currency = #{currency} AND p.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY p.expected_date, p.id
